# 2 Chronicles Chapter 21 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-he-lay-down Jehoshaphat with his-fathers and-he-was-buried with his-fathers in-city-of David and-he-reigned Jehoram his-son in-his-place.

**2** And-he-had brothers sons-of Jehoshaphat Azariah and-Jehiel and-Zechariah and-Azariah and-Michael and-Shephatiah all these sons-of Jehoshaphat king-of Israel.

**3** And-he-gave to-them their-father gifts many of-silver and-gold and-precious-things with fortified cities in-Judah and the-kingdom he-gave to-Jehoram for he was the-firstborn.

**4** And-he-arose Jehoram over kingdom-of his-father and-he-strengthened-himself and-he-killed all his-brothers with-the-sword and-also from-princes-of Israel.

**5** Son-of thirty-and-two years was-Jehoram in-his-reigning and-eight years he-reigned in-Jerusalem.

**6** And-he-walked in-way-of kings-of Israel as-that did house-of Ahab for daughter-of Ahab was for-him as-a-wife and-he-did the-evil in-eyes-of YHWH.

**7** And-not was-willing YHWH to-destroy house-of David for-sake-of the-covenant that He-cut with-David and-as-that He-said to-give to-him a-lamp and-to-his-sons all the-days.

**8** In-his-days rebelled Edom from-under hand-of Judah and-they-made-king over-them a-king.

**9** And-he-crossed-over Jehoram with his-commanders and-all the-chariots with-him and-he-arose by-night and-he-struck Edom the-surrounding against-him and-commanders-of the-chariots.

**10** And-it-rebelled Edom from-under hand-of Judah to this day then rebelled Libnah at-the-time that from-under his-hand for he-forsook YHWH God-of his-fathers.

**11** Also he made high-places in-hill-country-of Judah and-he-led-astray inhabitants-of Jerusalem and-he-thrust-away Judah.

**12** And-there-came to-him a-writing from-Elijah the-prophet saying thus says YHWH God-of David your-father because-that not you-walked in-ways-of Jehoshaphat your-father and-in-ways-of Asa king-of Judah

**13** and-you-walked in-way-of kings-of Israel and-you-led-astray Judah and-inhabitants-of Jerusalem as-led-astray house-of Ahab and-also your-brothers house-of your-father the-good from-you you-killed

**14** behold YHWH striking a-strike great in-your-people and-in-your-sons and-in-your-wives and-in-all your-possessions.

**15** And-you in-sicknesses many in-disease-of your-bowels until go-out your-bowels from the-disease days upon days.

**16** And-He-stirred-up YHWH against Jehoram spirit-of the-Philistines and-the-Arabians who are-on hand-of the-Cushites.

**17** And-they-came-up against-Judah and-they-broke-through-it and-they-carried-off all the-possessions the-found for-house-of the-king and-also his-sons and-his-wives and-not was-left to-him a-son except Jehoahaz the-smallest-of his-sons.

**18** And-after all this He-struck-him YHWH in-his-bowels with-a-disease without cure.

**19** And-it-was to-days from-days and-as-time the-going-out the-end to-days two went-out his-bowels with his-disease and-he-died in-sicknesses evil and-not made for-him his-people a-burning like-burning-of his-fathers.

**20** Son-of thirty-and-two he-was in-his-reigning and-eight years he-reigned in-Jerusalem and-he-went without desire and-they-buried-him in-city-of David and-not in-tombs-of the-kings.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **21:4**: he-killed all his-brothers — Fratricide to secure the throne. The contrast with Jehoshaphat's wise distribution of power (11:23) makes the horror more acute.

- **21:7**: lamp — The Hebrew ner (lamp) symbolizes dynastic continuity. Despite Jehoram's evil, God preserves the Davidic line for covenant's sake.

- **21:12**: a-writing from-Elijah — A letter from the northern prophet to a southern king. This is chronologically difficult (Elijah may have already been taken up), adding to the passage's enigmatic character.

- **21:20**: without desire — Hebrew lo be-chemdat, literally 'without being desired.' The most devastating epitaph in Chronicles: he died and nobody cared.


— EMET
